messages:
Maria G: Morning async — quick standup. What I did: finished the IAM policy audit for staging, flagged 3 overly broad roles. Blockers: need approvals for least-privilege PR. Today: will file PR + ping infra for prod KMS rotation window. @Kevin L @Rachel S any objections?

Kevin L: Reviewed staging IAM notes, looks good. I fixed one role in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 — needs review. No blockers on my side. I'll run the vulnscan on the affected service later today.

Rachel S: Ok to schedule KMS rotation? Compliance prefers Wed 10–11am PST. If we do dry-run tomorrow, we can roll Wed. @Maria G can you confirm?

Samir P: FYI blocked on access to key-ops account from CI — my token expired for the dry-run. Raised ticket ITS-1298, waiting for ops to reissue. If someone can grant me short-lived access, I can run the dry-run today.

Maria G: Thanks @Samir P — I'll ask infra to escalate. Also I'll open the PR for the least-privileged roles this morning.

EngSecBot: Automated scan finished: 4 low/2 medium findings in staging. See report: https://redwood-sec/reports/scan-1998765432

Kevin L: Medium ones are transitive deps — I'm on it, will send patch by EOD. :thumbsup:

Rachel S: If rotation is Wed, can we freeze infra merges for the window? Otherwise risk hot deploys. Suggest freeze 9:30–11:30am PST.

Maria G: Agreed. I'll post a Deploy freeze notice to #eng-sre once infra confirms. Action items: Maria -> open IAM PR; Kevin -> patch deps; Samir -> get temp creds; Rachel -> confirm compliance slot. If anything slips, we fallback to model-serving-standby variant. :eyes:

Kevin L: ACK. Ping me on PR review when ready.

Samir P: I got temp creds from ops (thanks!), running dry-run now. Will post results in thread.

Samir P: Dry-run log:
```
kms-rotate --env=staging --dry-run
Result: no downtime detected. 0 errors.
```

Maria G: Nice — great work everyone. I'll update the calendar invite and post freeze notice after infra confirms. End of thread.
